title: Suuf si
intro: Ci jamonoy fitna yu metti, ñu jox nit ku siiw xéewal yu bari ci àdduna, di natt ngërëm ak woyof. Tukkib nit ki dafay jàngale lu bari ci ni alal ji di yàggee ak li réy-réy mëna jur. Fexeel wane liy ruuh bii jaar-jaaram bind ci suuf si ci sunu suuf.
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci biir askan wi yonent bu mag jiite woon.
Allah may nama alal lu bari ba caabi samay alal nekkoon lu diis ci nit ñu bari ñu am doole.
Sama askan wi xamoon sama wërsëg digël na ma sàkku dëkkuwaayu àllaaxira ak li ma Yàlla jox te bañ a fàtte sama wàll ci àddina, ta def lu baax ni ma Yàlla baaxe woon.
Ma wax ak réy-réylu ni sama alal ju bari ji juddoo ci sama xam-xam ak sama coono, ma weddi benn xéewal bu Yàlla jox.
Bi ñu ma laajee ma jàppale wala ma nangu xéewali Yàlla, dama bañ ndax gëmoon naa ni samay moomeel ñooy samay moomeel.
Sama réy-réy gu ëpp ak sama noot, Yàlla dafa wax suuf si mu ubbeeku, wann ma ak sama dëkkuwaay.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
